definitions.explanation: Reading a text slowly and carefully, paying close attention to every detail of meaning, grammar, and vocabulary. Often involves looking up unknown words and analyzing sentence structure.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{精読|せいどく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
⟦{古典|こてん}→古典：00242_koten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{精読|せいどく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{深|ふか}めた→深める：02407_fukameru⟧。
examples.english: I deepened my understanding by reading the classic text closely.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{精読|せいどく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な⟦ポイント→ポイント：11283_pointo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ノート→ノート：00738_nooto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まとめた→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: Before the exam, I read the textbook carefully and summarized the key points in my notes.

notes:
USAGE:
Used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as {精読|せいどく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. Commonly contrasted with ⟦{多読|たどく}→多読：15981_tadoku⟧ (extensive reading) and ⟦{速読|そくどく}→速読：22402_sokudoku⟧ (speed reading). In academic and language learning contexts, {精読|せいどく} emphasizes deep comprehension over quantity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {精読|せいどく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to read carefully/intensively)
- ⟦{原文|げんぶん}→原文：20563_genbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{精読|せいどく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to read the original text closely)
- {精読|せいどく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{多読|たどく}→多読：15981_tadoku⟧ (intensive and extensive reading)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{多読|たどく}→多読：15981_tadoku⟧: extensive reading — reading widely for quantity (opposite approach)
- ⟦{熟読|じゅくどく}→熟読：17535_jukudoku⟧: reading carefully and thoroughly, very similar to {精読|せいどく} but emphasizes repeated or deep engagement
